title: RecordsSpec authority event payloads
description: Payload envelopes for the four trellis.authority.* event types (Operational Companion §25). Engine-neutral: nothing here names an evaluator. Evaluator-specific material travels only in a decision's `detail`, whose schema the producing contract owns. RecordsSpec's admission binds each event type to its fragment here and to its ledger. Authored once in trellis/specs; other repositories vendor this file byte-identical.

contractId.description: A server contract id. Both authority and authority-decisions ledgers are shared per scope across contracts; "genesis" is reserved for genesis tupleChange grants and rejected by server contract loaders.

objectRef.description: A typed object: `<type>:<id>`. The bounds are structural; an evaluator's own limits are enforced by the server that admits the command.

subjectRef.description: A typed object, or a set of subjects related to one: `<type>:<id>#<relation>`. A wildcard subject is not admitted in an authority fact. The bounds are structural; an evaluator's own limits are enforced by the server that admits the command.

position.description: A ledger prefix: its tree size and tree head hash.

tupleChange.description: Payload of trellis.authority.grant.v1 and trellis.authority.revocation.v1. A pure function of the command that produced it; for a genesis authority_admin grant, a pure deterministic function of (scope, administrator) with contract "genesis" and the canonical genesis service actor, identical across all servers.

actor.description: The principal who issued the command. For genesis grants, the deterministic canonical genesis actor (service:<digest> derived from the fixed domain tag "stack-authz-genesis-operator-v1"), distinct from the calling server's HTTP AppendActor.

contract.description: The server contract that admitted the command, or "genesis" for a scope's genesis authority_admin grants.

artifact.description: One policy artifact, carried whole so the ledger's export is self-sufficient.

content.description: The artifact's bytes as UTF-8 text.

activation.description: Payload of trellis.authority.activation.v1: a contract's policy became the governing configuration for the scope.

builtAt.description: The ledger prefix the evaluator was reconciled to before this fact was appended.

actor.description: The service principal that performed the activation.

configuration.description: Digest of the operator configuration that selected this policy.

artifacts.description: Every policy artifact the policy digest pins, each exactly once. Admission verifies each digest against its content and that paths are unique; the producer verifies the set is complete.

decision.description: Payload of trellis.authority.decision.v1: an effect that was authorized and attempted. It does not establish delivery.

point.description: The authorization point within the effect's protocol.

detailSchema.description: URI of the schema that governs `detail`.

detail.description: Producer-owned evaluation detail. Opaque to RecordsSpec; bound by the event's own hash.

attempt.description: The identity of this attempt at the effect (for a release, one download attempt). One record per attempt; a retry of the same append resends the same bytes.

instance.description: The effect instance the attempt belongs to (for example a job id).

authorityPrefix.description: The authority-ledger prefix every relationship in this decision was evaluated at.

policyRef.description: The policy in force: its digest, the profile-set digest it was validated against, and the operator's revision.
